name: print-social-retro-branded-ui-poster-red-and-cream
title: Retro poster with huge cream bubble type over a red-toned portrait
whatItIs: A red-framed portrait poster with a man in a red beanie and white round sunglasses. The word 'Retro' in massive cream rounded letters sits above his head, overlapped by the hat. Small caption text and a pill button sit at the lower area.
whatItMeans: Bold, nostalgic and fashionable; type interlocking with the subject makes it feel like a magazine cover.
techniques: Let the subject overlap the giant headline so it appears behind the hat.
Tint the whole photo red to match a brand palette.
Use a fat rounded 70s-style type in cream.
Add small caption and a pill button as a subtle UI layer.

vocabulary.definition: Placing letters behind a cut-out person for depth.
A photo treated to appear in shades of red.
